title: Fix sudoers file permissions
summary: Restore correct ownership and permissions for /etc/sudoers if they were accidentally changed, which can cause sudo to fail.

steps.explain: Set the owner and group of /etc/sudoers to root.
Set the permissions to 0440 (read-only for root and group).

rollback.explain: If sudo is completely broken, you may need to boot into a live USB or recovery mode to fix these permissions.

warnings: Incorrect permissions on /etc/sudoers will prevent sudo from working. Ensure you have root access via another method (su, live USB) before attempting this if sudo is already failing.
